observed.caption: An elevated wide view of a green urban park with a lake and white tents in the foreground and a cloudy city skyline in the background.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor urban park viewed from an elevated position under an overcast sky. In the foreground there is green grass, a paved circular walkway, scattered trees and dense foliage, with small figures of people sitting and lying on the grass. White peaked event tents are clustered in the middle ground in front of a calm lake surrounded by trees. Beyond the lake an elevated roadway stretches horizontally, and behind it a skyline of numerous high-rise buildings of varying heights, colors and designs rises against a cloudy gray sky. The lighting is diffuse and the overall scene is a wide landscape view of parkland contrasting with the distant city.
